recipes.name: Baked Creamy Pumpkin Risotto
ingredients: 600 g / 20 oz   pumpkin (weight after peeling and deseeding) (, diced into 1.7cm/2/3" cubes (about 4 heaped cups) (Note 2))
1/4 cup dry white wine ((or water or broth))

recipes.name: Birria Tacos
ingredients: 25 g (0.9 oz)  guajillo chillies, dried ((~4 pieces, heaped 3/4 cup once chopped) (Note 1))
45 g (1.6 oz)  ancho chillies, dried ((~2-3 pieces, 1 cup once chopped) (Note 1))
6 g (0.2 oz)  chillies de arbol, dried ((~6 pieces, 2 tbsp once chopped) (Note 1))
1/2 cup chilli soaking water ((reserve after simmering))
1 small onion (, roughly sliced (~tennis ball size))
1.3 kg/2.6 lb   chuck beef (, cut into 6 large pieces (or boneless beef short ribs - 1.8kg/3.6 lb bone-in) (Note 3))
2 cups beef stock / broth (, low sodium)
1  cinnamon stick ((substitute 1/4 tsp powder, but it's not quite the same))
3  bay leaves (, preferably fresh else dried)
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar ((or regular white vinegar, red or white wine vinegar))
2 1/2 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +30% for flakes))
1/2 cup finely chopped coriander / cilantro leaves
3 1/2 cups (350g)  shredded Colby, Monterey Jack or (Oaxaca cheese (if you can get it) (Note 6))
Your favorite salsa or hot sauce (, optional)

recipes.name: Chinese Beef and Broccoli Noodles
ingredients: 350 - 400 g / 12 - 14 oz   beef rump or fillet (, thinly sliced (or other quick cooking cut of beef))
1  large head broccoli (, broken into small florets)
400 - 450g / 14 - 15 oz   egg noodles ((hokkien, lo mein, singapore - from the fridge) (Note 1))
1 tsp white sugar ((omit if using Mirin))
1/8 tsp Chinese five spice powder ((not critical))

recipes.name: Chinese Steamed Fish with Ginger Shallot Sauce
ingredients: 2 x 350 - 400g / 12 - 13 oz  bream or snapper fish (, gutted, scaled and cleaned (Note 1))
2  stems of shallots ((scallions / green onions), diagonally julienned to 5cm/2" length)
4 x 3cm / 1 x 2" piece of  ginger julienned
4 tbsp oil ((vegetable, canola or peanut oil))

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cake for a Crowd
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil (, or other plain flavoured oil like canola, grapeseed, rapeseed, sunflower)
1 cup boiling water ((makes the chocolate flavour "bloom"))
4 cups (500 g)  soft icing sugar / powdered sugar (, sifted (Note 4))
1/2 cup (120 g)  smooth peanut butter ((spread, not pure) (Note 5))
1/2 cup chocolate chips or melts ((US: semi sweet chips))
2 tbsp cream ((thickened/heavy or pure, not low fat))
3 tbsp peanut butter (, warmed in microwave to make it runny)
120g / 4 oz   mini Reece's Peanut Butter Cups
10+  miniature Reece's Peanut Butter Cups (, halved)

recipes.name: Chorizo Baked Beans on Toast
ingredients: 14 oz / 420g   canned cannellini beans ((or any other white beans, such as navy), drained)
1 tbsp sugar ((brown, white or raw - or even honey))
1/2 tsp cayenne pepper or red chili flakes ((optional))
Eggs (, cooked to your liking sunny side up (or poached or boiled))

recipes.name: Whipped Feta Dip
ingredients: 400g / 10 oz  Danish feta (, at room temp (ie. the creamy sort, not crumbly Greek sort, Note 1))
125g/ 4 oz  cream cheese (at room temp) or 3/4 cup yogurt ((Note 2))
1/4 tsp garlic (, crushed using garlic press (Note 3))
Pinch of  chilli / red pepper flakes (, optional)
Lebanese (, pita or flat bread wedges)

recipes.name: Crispy Zucchini Fritters
ingredients: 2  green onions (, halved then finely sliced)
1/4 cup parmesan (, grated (fresh or store bought))

recipes.name: Flan Pâtissier (French Custard Tart)
ingredients: 2  vanilla beans (, seeds scraped, beans reserved (Note 1))
120g / 4.2 oz  egg yolks ((~6 to 7 large eggs, 100 ml, Note 2))
50g (5 tbsp)  unsalted butter (, cut into 1cm cubes (cold))
2 sheets butter puff pastry, FROZEN ((25cm / 10" squares, 185g/6oz each) (Note 4))

recipes.name: Fondant Potatoes (Melting potatoes)
ingredients: 4 x 400g/14 oz large floury potatoes (, peeled (Aus: Sebago (dirt brushed), US: Russet, UK: King Edward))
3 tbsp / 50g  unsalted butter (, cut into 1cm / 1/2" cubes)
1 cup chicken stock / broth (, low sodium (or vegetable))

recipes.name: Hot Ham and Cheese Sliders
ingredients: 12  standard or 24 small soft white roll slab ((23 x 33cm / 9 x 13" slab) - Note 1)
1/3 cup American mustard ( (ie bright yellow stuff) - Note 2)
350g/ 12 oz   ham (, shaved or thinly sliced (up to 500g/1lb, Note 3))
250g/ 8 oz  Swiss cheese ( or other melting cheese slices (10 - 12 slices))
1 tsp garlic powder ((sub fresh garlic, finely minced))

recipes.name: Italian Almond Cookies (Ricciarelli) - gluten free!
ingredients: 2 cups  almond meal or blanched ground almonds ((Note 1))
2  egg whites (, at room temperature (from 2 large eggs, Note 4))

recipes.name: Italian Meatball Soup
ingredients: 1  lightly packed cup of sliced white sandwich bread (, torn into small pieces, crusts removed (Note 1))
1/2 cup grated onion ((brown, white or yellow))
3 oz / 100g   ground pork ((mince) or more ground beef (Note 2))
1 cup onion (, finely chopped (white, brown or yellow))
8 oz / 250g   spaghetti ((dried, not fresh or cooked))

recipes.name: Lamb tagine
ingredients: 1.6 kg/ 3.2lb  boneless lamb shoulder, trim the fat, then ( cut in 3.5cm / 1.5" cubes (1kg/2lb after trimming))
1 kg / 2 lb  lamb stewing meat or shoulder, already trimmed of fat (cut in 3.5cm / 1.5" cubes)
1 cup dried apricots (, whole (Note 2 for olives option))
2 - 3 tsp lemon zest ((just use 1 whole lemon, Note 3 for preserved lemon))
1 tsp cayenne pepper ((can reduce for less spicy - Note 4))
1 1/2 batches couscous ((I just use plain, but you can add the fruit and nuts if you want))

recipes.name: Lebanese Fattoush
ingredients: 5 cups cos/romaine lettuce (, cut into large bite size pieces)
2  Lebanese cucumbers (, thinly sliced into 3mm rounds)
1 cup cherry tomatoes (, halved (~200g), or 1 1/2 regular tomatoes cut into large chunks)
1/2 cup mint leaves (, lightly packed (large ones torn in half))
1  medium garlic clove (, finely grated or crushed using garlic crusher)

recipes.name: Middle Eastern Shredded Lamb
ingredients: 2 tsp ground cardamon (or sub with ginger)
1.5 - 2 kg / 3 - 4 lb  lamb shoulder (bone in, trimmed of excess fat)

recipes.name: Mongolian Lamb
ingredients: 350g / 12 oz  lamb meat (backstrap/fillet, mid loin chops,  shoulder - or any cut in Note 1)
1 tbsp light soy sauce ((or all purpose, Note 3))
1 tsp light soy sauce ((or all purpose, Note 3))
1 1/2 tsp Sambal Oelak or other chilli paste ((or omit for no spice))
3 tbsp hoisin sauce ((I used Lee Kum Kee brand))
2 tbsp vegetable oil ((or canola or peanut))
1  large onion (, cut into large 2.5cm / 1" squares)

recipes.name: Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup (65 ml)  white wine or rose (, dry (Note 2 subs))
1/2 cup (125 ml)  chicken or vegetable broth
2 tsp fresh thyme leaves ((or 1/4 - 1/2 tsp dried))

recipes.name: Nutella Crêpes
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups plain flour / all-purpose flour (, sifted)
3 tbsp caster sugar / superfine sugar (, regular white sugar is fine too)
3  large eggs (, (55g/2oz each in shell) - fridge cold is fine)
2 cups full fat milk (, but works with lite milk too)
2 tbsp vegetable oil or other neutral flavoured oil ((Note 1))
45 g (3 tbsp)   unsalted butter (, cut into small cubes (for cooking))
Icing sugar / powdered sugar (, for dusting)

recipes.name: Oven Baked Pork Chops with Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil ((or vegetable or canola oil))
4  pork chops / cutlets (, around 200-250g/7-8oz each including bone (Note 4))
800g/ 1.6 lb  baby potatoes (, larger ones cut in half (Note 5))

recipes.name: Reuben Sandwich recipe!
ingredients: 1 kg / 2 lb  homemade pastrami (1 quantity, easy!) ((Note 1))
350g/ 12 oz   white cabbage (, thinly shredded (1/4 large head, 6 - 8 big handfuls))
1 tsp cooking salt / kosher salt ((halve for table salt, +50% for flakes))
1/4 cup sour cream ((can sub more mayo))
2.5 tbsp sriracha, spicy ketchup or Chili Sauce ((or 1/4 cup ketchup + 2 tsp tabasco) (Note 3))

recipes.name: San Fran Chicken Salad with Yoghurt Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1 cup Greek yoghurt, preferably full fat
1/4 tsp EACH dried dill, parsley, chives, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper (Note 1)
Squeeze of lemon juice, to taste
200 - 250 g / 7 - 8 oz   chicken breast, halved horizontally
1/2  red onion, halved then finely sliced
1/2 cup white wine vinegar, or cider vinegar
3 cups kale, torn into bite size pieces (Note 2)
4 cups cos lettuce, romaine or other crispy lettuce, torn or cut into bite size pieces
1/2  fennel, shaved (0.5 mm / 1/5" thickness) or finely sliced

recipes.name: Thai Meatballs
ingredients: 500 g / 1 lb   pork mince ((ground pork, or chicken))
1 tbsp lemongrass paste (or finely chopped fresh) (Note 1)
3  kaffir lime leaves, stem removed and very finely shredded, optional extra (Note 2)
3  Thai or birds eye chillies (, seeds removed and finely chopped (Note 3))
1/4 cup coriander/cilantro (, leaves and stem finely chopped (Note 4))
1 tbsp fish sauce (can sub with soy sauce if required)
3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs ((+ extra 1/4 cup if needed))
1/2 cup / 125 ml  sweet chilli sauce (, store bought (Note 5))
2 tbsp lime juice (, plus more to taste)
Coriander/cilantro leaves (, finely sliced large red chillies)

recipes.name: Tabbouleh White Bean Salad
ingredients: 800g / 24 oz (2 cans) white beans (like cannellini, navy/haricot, butter beans) (, drained (Note 1 & 3))
3  cucumbers ((or 1 1/2 long English/Telegraph cucumbers), cut into 1.25cm / 1/2" pieces)
1 cup parsley (, roughly chopped (1 large bunch))
1  garlic clove (, small, minced using garlic press)
1/2 tsp salt (, kosher/cooking salt (1/4 tsp table salt))
